Filters map results by search keyword; 4 links in page but only 2 match 'blog'

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createEngine, mapUrls } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { mapSearch: "blog", maxDepth: 0, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await mapUrls(engine, url);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
